concepts.prompt: Game pickup item concept: a skill crystal. A single large faceted crystal shard, tall and pointed with clean bold flat facets and a few small secondary crystals at its foot, made of neutral pale clear-white quartz with a faint frosted inner glow (neutral, untinted, so it can be colour-tinted later), set upright in a small round carved wooden cradle base with simple leaf carvings and a brass rim. About 0.40 m tall in total. Stylised Palworld / Animo-class game item prop, deliberately chunky and oversized, exaggerated readable silhouette that still reads clearly from 10-15 metres, soft bevelled edges, soft hand-painted PBR look, natural palette matching the Meadows key-art reference (sage and leaf greens, warm gold, cream, slate blue, teal). Single isolated object standing upright on its flat base, full object visible and centred, plain neutral light-grey background, even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no ground plane, no people, no creatures, no text, no letters, no labels, no red or crimson anywhere.
concepts.verdict: CHOSEN: tall faceted pale quartz shard with smaller crystals at its foot, carved wooden cradle with sage leaf carvings and brass rims; 3 consistent views

agent_visual_verdict: Good: tall faceted pale crystal with smaller crystals at its foot, carved wooden cradle with sage leaves and brass rims. Crystal is pale grey-green, neutral enough to tint per element in code. Cradle rim slopes slightly on one side (from the concept). 0.21 x 0.40 x 0.21 m.
